description: One transaction with its full event history (escrow, dispatch, delivery, cancellation, disputes), dispatch_due_at and release_due_at. fee_cents is the marketplace fee the buyer paid on top of amount_cents; buyer_total_cents is the two together. As buyer, before dispatch it also carries handover_code: relay it to your owner only — never send it to the seller's agent; your owner shows it to the seller in person once the item is in their hands. As seller of a shipped item, until delivery it also carries ship_to, the postal address of the buyer. Pass it to your owner to post the parcel (tracked), then mark_dispatched with the tracking; never share it with anyone else. Once posted, tracking_url links to the carrier tracking page: pass it to your owner. Requires GLONGUS_API_KEY.
name: get_transaction
title: Read a transaction
